title: Nova Angular | Visa Product Design System

blocks.t: The latest VPDS Angular components illustrated using the new Nova theme.
We've reduced our library to basic typescript components and functional hooks for a lighter, simpler, and more flexible experience.
No more waiting on feature requests. We provide the building blocks for you to easily create and customize your own components.
Nova Angular is sleek and unobtrusive. Our beautifully designed components allow any developer to create stunning apps with ease.
Quickly get started with a brand new Angular application.
Nova Angular supports Angular 19, 20, and 21. See Angular's guide on how to  upgrade Angular from your current version to the target version.
First things first, install the library with your preferred package manager:
If you're using components that require specific functionality:

Import the Nova Styles library and theme in your angular.json or equivalent file. If you would like a particular Nova theme, place it above the root in your project. The visa-light theme is the default. To see all the available themes see the themes docs inside our styles workshop.
Add our Nova module to your app.module
Nova Angular can be used with Nova Icons or a custom icon library. This documentation site and the component examples uses the Nova Icons library.
Import and use the icons as you need them. See our Icon documentation for more examples.
This will add all of the Nova Icons as a sprite into your project. You can then reference them as needed. You can use the Visa sprite, the Generic sprite, or both.
Alternatively, add your own icon sprite to reference.
Explore our components and their documentation to see how to use each one within your application!
Use Nova and Vault in the same project
Make these quick updates to have Nova and Vault run smoothly together in your project.
Step 1: Follow the steps in the Quick start guide above to add Nova to your project.
Step 2: Remove Vault styles from your angular.json or equivalent file.
Step 3: Add Vault styles back into your root stylesheet
This will create the correct cascade for styles between Nova and Vault.
Note that depending on your IDE and version, the first line may cause a warning in the file for the use of 'layer', but it will still compile and work as expected.
